notes.title: AI & Bugfix Update v1.24.2
notes.content:
Attacking a unit will now give away your position to the unit being attacked, unless you are cloaked.
 Fixed a bug that may have caused a friendly unit to run from an attacker when it could have otherwise attacked.


This AI update is designed to make ranged units more balanced. Before, if you attacked a unit from far away & outside of the target's sight range, that target would run away. Now, the target will act like it can see the incoming shot & know where to engage. This should give short-ranged units more of a chance against long-ranged units, as they will try to close the distance even if the long-ranged unit is initially out of its sight range. Your friendly units will have this same change too -- you will see individually attacking enemy units outside of your sight range.

This is considered a bigger update, so leaderboards have been bumped up a version number.

v1.24.1 fixes a bug that allowed seeing stealthy, attacking enemy units.

v1.24.2 clears up an ambiguous situation where detectors could kinda sorta see cloaked attackers outside of visual range. Now they clearly shouldn't and run if attacked, as detecting units need to be within visual range to properly detect a cloaked unit.

notes.title: Balancing Update v1.23.4
notes.content:
The "Salvage Killed Resources" special ability can now only be applied to stationary units (e.g. buildings).

This prevents a balancing issue where very strong offensive units could finance themselves through their kills.

notes.title: Summary of Updates Since Release
notes.content:
Adapt or Perish has seen many significant improvements since release:

 Increased unit intelligence by adding "Overkill" consideration
 Additional late game challenges beyond just stronger enemies (more aggressive AI & more varied enemy unit generation)
 Virtual Reality improvements, like SteamVR keyboard integration & UI hiding
 Sight recalculation, so units better utilize the exact sight value paid for
 Important balancing & exploit patches
 Bugfixes

Want to chat about Adapt or Perish, new development projects & previous games? Come join the Phr00t's Software Discord @ https://discord.gg/gqZRTkk

notes.title: v1.23.3: Healer Stacking & Unity Update
notes.content:
Units can now only be healed by up to 6 other healers at a time
 Updated build from Unity 5.6.5p4 to 5.6.7

notes.title: v1.23.2: Level Boost Limits & Bugfixes
notes.content:
Units now can only increase their individual level beyond your Global Level (provided by Global Level Upgrade buildings) by 4 via killing & level upgrade crates.

Level boosts provided by Elemental Resistance & Damage types matching terrain biomes is unaffected. So, a unit standing on Plasma terrain, whom is Plasma Resistant & Damaging, could be at most 6 levels ahead of your Global Level.

This addresses issues with "super" units becoming progressively powerful without any further base support or adjustments to strategy

 Fixed a cosmetic bug that caused unit rotations to get stuck, particularly small flying units


v1.23.1 provides a cosmetic bugfix for projectiles visually tracking a blinked unit, even though the projectiles miss

v1.23.2:

 Fixed a rare loading bug that may corrupt saved games
 Further explained how "Explodes on Contact" works

notes.title: v1.22.3: Build List Bugfix
notes.content:
Implemented a workaround that hopefully addresses the occasional bug that makes the Build List unresponsive to mouse clicks. Seems to be related to an internal Unity 5.6 bug!
 Fixed a backend "WasDeathAt" exception issue (which probably didn't cause any symptoms, but was inefficient)

notes.title: v1.22.2: Converted become Followers
notes.content: Units that have been converted on death will now automatically become a follower of the unit that converted them

notes.title: v1.22.1: Unit Editor Bugfixes
notes.content:
Leading & trailing spaces will be trimmed on unit names, which previously caused "Undefined Build Unit" errors
 Randomness of new unit model generation improved in the editor. Also fixes a bug that caused models to get "stuck" on flying or land types
 Added "minor" version numbers, so small updates like these don't need to change Leaderboard entries

notes.title: v1.22: MORE Late Game Challenges & Bufixes
notes.content:
Now units may become more varied & powerful after a Grand Overseer defeat. Enemy unit types will be able to choose from faster movement & larger "base" health/shield stats
 Fixed a bug that made the fullscreen to windowed fallback check too sensitive
 Now games will track what version you started with, so scores will only be posted to that version's leaderboard
 Fixed a bug that caused terrain to flicker, especially when zoomed out & at high game speed settings


Hoping this game be pretty stable on this version for a bit, and allow this Leaderboard to collect some good entries!

notes.title: v1.21: Late Game Challenge & Fullscreen Fix
notes.content:
Now every 3rd Overseer will be a Grand Overseer
 After killing the first Grand Overseer, and for each Overseer killed thereafter, the lowest resistance limit will increase. After around 11 Overseer kills, the game will always play in Extreme resistance!
 When trying to play fullscreen in a non-native aspect ratio, Adapt or Perish will fallback to windowed mode. This is to prevent a suspected Unity 5.6 bug that causes inaccurate mouse clicks

notes.title: v1.20: "Overkill" Intelligence & Bugfixes
notes.content:
Units will now consider if a unit is about to die before shooting more at it. This will speed up both your attacks, and enemy attacks on you!
 Fixed a pair of very rare backend crashes that may have caused the build list interface to become unresponsive. Hopefully this will end this hard to reproduce bug!
 Fixed a timing bug when setting game speed in the Options menu (instead of the + / - hotkeys)
 CPU performance improvements in calculating "unit died here" icons in "fog of war" areas

notes.title: v1.19: "Fog of War" Icon Fixes & Self-Replication
notes.content:
Fixed a bug introduced in v1.18 that broke previously explored reminder icons for crates & resource mines
 Units can now build themselves (except buildings still cannot build other buildings)

notes.title: v1.18: Sight Changes & Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Heads up everyone! Some relatively big sight changes are coming!

Currently, units reveal terrain in a square pattern instead of a circle. Although this "works," it has some undesirable behavior:

1) Units attack & detect stealthy units in a circle, as they should -- so the terrain revealed would poorly match detection and attack ranges.

2) Only sight values of 5, 9 and 15 mattered due to all of the rounding happening -- which was unintentional.

3) Enemies properly see in a circle, so your units revealing them in a square provided the player an unexpected advantage.

4) Also due to the rounding issues, it didn't matter where your unit was on a terrain "cell" -- it always revealed a certain number of terrain "cells" away.

This update fixes all of that by properly calculating terrain (and enemy) visibility in a circle. The "unfortunate" side effect is, units will reveal less terrain than they did before -- but it will behave much better.

This update also:

 Fixed pulldown menus not displaying selected values in the "Simple Contrast" UI theme
 Fixed Unit Identifiers when trying to show units with no letters in their names (e.g. "12345")


If you are having crashing problems when starting the game, check the FAQ in the forums for a likely solution!

notes.title: v1.17: Deleted Unit Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Deleting a unit definition that is being built should no longer "break" the unit doing the building
 Deleted units that still exist on the playing field should now be properly labeled as an "old" unit, even if a new unit definition gets created with the same name

notes.title: v1.16: VR & Fast Scroll Updates
notes.content:
Added a new "Fast Scroll" option, which will speed up keyboard scrolling
 VR: SteamVR keyboard is now used to edit unit names (if you don't like the autogenerated names)
 VR: Added a "Toggle UI" button to show & hide the UI as desired


Steam Leaderboards are not lost! If you are running v1.16 and want to see old scores, select v1.15 in the Leaderboards dialog.

notes.title: v1.15 Hotfix: Unit Identifiers & Deleted Units
notes.content: If you deleted a unit definition for something already out in the field, then tried to turn on Unit Identifiers -- it would cause units to visually disappear due to a background crash. v1.15 should fix this! Your saved games should be fine too.

notes.title: Major Build System Update
notes.content:
Adapt or Perish is out of beta and reached v1.3 -- getting ready for release early this year (hopefully within about a month). A recent update, thanks to feedback from testers, greatly streamlines how units you define get built.

I removed the tutorial video, since not only was it getting graphically outdated, it was going through some confusing mechanics that no longer exist. The in-game tutorial & Game Guide has been redesigned, reducing the need for an external video tutorial.

Follow progress & more on Discord: https://discord.gg/gqZRTkk
